chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from 'Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadah from 'Ammar al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"If a man forgets the Qunut in any part of the prayer until he bows, then his prayer is valid and there is nothing upon him, but it is not permissible for him to leave it intentionally."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one forgets Qunut during prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the status of Qunut as a recommended (mustahabb) act rather than a pillar, confirming that forgetting it does not invalidate the prayer. It distinguishes between unintentional omission, which carries no penalty, and intentional neglect, which is discouraged, reflecting the Shia juristic view on the flexibility of supererogatory acts within the obligatory prayer structure.
